extracted.intended_audience: media leaders, publishers, editors, journalists, digital revenue and product/technology officers, printing/production executives, media-tech entrepreneurs and service providers worldwide
extracted.subtask_description: Organizational mission-and-values guidance for news publishers and related professionals, describing standards and services for press freedom, editorial quality, business sustainability and innovation. The page explains what WAN-IFRA expects, promotes, and provides to support independent news media globally.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protect the rights of journalists and publishers / operate independent media
rubrics_metrics.description: Our mission is to protect the rights of journalists and publishers around the world to operate independent media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WAN-IFRA positions press freedom as central to its mission: protect those rights, advocate for independence of news media organisations, and engage with public authorities and institutions to safeguard the ability to operate independent media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote editorial quality and professional practice
rubrics_metrics.description: We protect the rights of journalists and publishers to operate a free media, and promote editorial quality and professional practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Promotion of editorial quality includes defending editorial integrity and encouraging professional standards and practices among journalists and editors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Business sustainability as guarantee of independence
rubrics_metrics.description: We believe that business sustainability is the best guarantee for publishers to remain independent and contribute to freedom of expression in open societies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on viable news media business models — WAN-IFRA provides services and expertise to help members innovate and prosper financially as a path to editorial independence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media innovation — generate new ideas and applied research
rubrics_metrics.description: We provide our members with new ideas and applied research by bringing the outside in, looking beyond what is already known.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support includes research, idea exchange, and programs to help members adopt technological and business innovations; WAN-IFRA acts as a driver of new business models and a promoter of open innovation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advance quality standards in production workflow and business value chain
rubrics_metrics.description: Working as a representative trade body to elaborate and advance quality standards in the production workflow and business value chain.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes sharing best practices in business and technology, fostering international cooperation among publishers, and promoting high technical/production standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advocacy on global media policy and internet governance
rubrics_metrics.description: We advocate on major global media policy issues that impact the independence of the press and promote common principles that contribute to an inclusive, multi-stakeholder, effective, legitimate, and evolving global Internet governance framework.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WAN-IFRA engages with public authorities, institutions, and trade bodies to influence policy; advocacy is framed as protecting press freedom and the conditions for independent news media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide innovation and business development services
rubrics_metrics.description: Innovation and business development: With dedicated platforms and marketplaces like the Global Alliance for Media Innovation, or our advisory services and training programmes to individual company members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Services include advisory work, training, dedicated platforms/marketplaces, and tailored programs to help member organizations develop new products, services, and business models.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide news, strategic insights and market intelligence
rubrics_metrics.description: News and Insights with strategic, and market insights with print and online publications, special reports, white papers, and online targeted resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WAN-IFRA delivers timely analysis, reports, and white papers to inform members' strategic decisions and to surface trends and best practices in the industry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilitate networking and peer learning
rubrics_metrics.description: Networking: Weave with business peers around the world, learn from success and failures, share business strategies, and connect emerging themes and insights.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Networking opportunities are framed as ways to improve performance and speed decision-making through peer learning, events (e.g., World News Media Congress), and knowledge exchange.

rubrics_metrics.name: Be solution-driven and deliver member-oriented services
rubrics_metrics.description: We are solution-driven, delivering services where members can find answers to their challenges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WAN-IFRA emphasizes practical, actionable support — advisory, training, and platforms designed to solve members' real business and editorial problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embrace proactivity and ability to deal with uncertainty
rubrics_metrics.description: We have the ability to deal with uncertainty. We are proactive and a driver of new business models, with a holistic point of view and a sense of urgency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organizational stance: encourage members to be proactive in experimenting with business models and to adopt a holistic, urgent approach to industry changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to curiosity, open innovation, networking, diversity and integrity
rubrics_metrics.description: We are committed to curiosity, open innovation and networking, sharing professional knowledge inside and outside the organisation. We champion diversity and promote integrity in all we do.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Values-oriented standard: foster inclusive practices, knowledge-sharing, diverse participation, and ethical behavior across the news ecosystem.

rubrics_metrics.name: Solidarity in action and community commitment
rubrics_metrics.description: Driven by members, publishers, associations and technology suppliers, we believe in solidarity in action and community commitment, and we draw on the collective pool of strengths and skills to the benefit of each member of our community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages collaborative approaches among publishers and suppliers — practical cooperation, shared projects, and mutual support as standards of industry practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Champion the future of news through ethical journalism and editorial integrity
rubrics_metrics.description: We are passionate about the future of news, through the promotion of a free press, quality journalism, editorial integrity and adoption of these values by new generations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on intergenerational adoption of editorial ethics and practices: mentorship, education, and standards that sustain journalism quality over time.
